mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo (trip_id, stop_id, media_type, file_name, original_name, duration_sec, taken_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{stopId}, #{mediaType}, #{fileName}, #{originalName}, #{durationSec}, #{takenAt}::timestamp)
mapper.select: SELECT p.photo_id AS id, p.stop_id, p.media_type, '/api/photos/' || p.photo_id || '/file' AS url, p.duration_sec, (p.taken_at::date - t.start_date + 1) AS day, to_char(p.taken_at, 'HH24:MI') AS taken_at FROM photo p JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = p.trip_id WHERE p.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY p.taken_at, p.photo_id

SELECT p.photo_id, p.trip_id, p.stop_id, p.media_type, p.file_name, p.original_name, p.duration_sec, to_char(p.taken_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS taken_at FROM photo p JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = p.trip_id WHERE p.photo_id = #{photoId} AND t.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT t.trip_id, t.title, t.start_date::text AS start_date, t.end_date::text AS end_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_stop s WHERE s.trip_id = t.trip_id AND s.state <> 'skipped') AS place_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo p WHERE p.trip_id = t.trip_id AND p.media_type = 'photo') AS photo_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo p WHERE p.trip_id = t.trip_id AND p.media_type = 'video') AS video_count FROM trip t WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.status = 'done' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.start_date DESC, t.trip_id DESC
